innovations: Proposes PolyOCR, a unified OCR foundation model family integrating recognition, localization, parsing, extraction, understanding and reasoning in one generative framework.
Introduces Competence-Guided Policy Optimization (CGPO) that dynamically routes on-policy distillation based on calibrated teacher quality and teacher-student competence gap.
Builds a large-scale OCR data engine with cross-model verification and targeted synthesis to cover underrepresented capabilities.
